name: io.github.0Smallcat0/otto
description: Local AI-operated financial terminal: market data, paper trading, backtesting, news and portfolio state behind one safety-gated action contract. Live trading, credential entry and code execution are unreachable through the tool surface.

environmentVariables.name: LOCAL_TERMINAL_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of an already-running Otto backend. Omit to let the MCP server start and manage its own.

environmentVariables.name: LOCAL_TERMINAL_STATE_ROOT
environmentVariables.description: Where local state (portfolios, paper books, the judgment ledger) is written. Defaults to the checkout when run from source, otherwise ~/.otto.
